title: Speaches
tagline: Self-hosted speech to text and text to speech with OpenAI-compatible APIs
author: OrcVole

apikey.message: Get your API key: open a Terminal for this app (the `>_` button) and run `cat /app/data/.secrets/keys.env`. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` to the /v1 endpoints.

uikey.message: The web UI at / is open to anyone as a shell: it cannot transcribe or synthesise anything without a key. Paste the same API key into the UI's key box once per browser.

models.message: Models download on demand into /var/lib/speaches. The default STT and TTS models preload on first boot: watch the app's Logs for progress before relying on them.
